title: 36(b)(1) Arms Sales Notification
summary: This Federal Register notice publishes the unclassified text of a Section 36(b)(1) arms sales notification (Transmittal No. 11-07), a letter to the Speaker of the House with attached policy justification and Sensitivity of Technology. The notice text available here is only the cover page; the transmittal details (country, equipment, values, contractors, and date) appear only in graphic images that were not included as text, so those fields are left null.

DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE

Office of the Secretary

[Transmittal Nos. 11-07]


36(b)(1) Arms Sales Notification

AGENCY: Department of Defense, Defense Security Cooperation Agency.

ACTION: Notice.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY: The Department of Defense is publishing the unclassified text 
of a section 36(b)(1) arms sales notification. This is published to 
fulfill the requirements of section 155 of Public Law 104-164 dated 
July 21, 1996.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Mr. John Unglesbee, DSCA/DBO/CFM, 
(703) 601-6026.
    The following is a copy of a letter to the Speaker of the House of

[[Page 40704]]

Representatives, Transmittal 11-07 with attached transmittal, policy 
justification, and Sensitivity of Technology.

    Dated: July 5, 2011.
Aaron Siegel,
Alternate OSD Federal Register Liaison Officer, Department of Defense.
